Subject: Need help with a tenancy eviction case

Hello, my name is Sunanda Krishnan. I am a 75-year-old taxi driver living in Chennai. I have a tenancy problem with Manoj Hegde involving INR 1,60,000/- in rent, and the tenant has sublet the flat without permission. My case number is R.C.A. No. 2358/2025 in the Chennai District Court. Can your firm advise me on what to do next? You can call me on +91 74848 27351 or email sunanda.krishnan@example.in.
